test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’.**

‘I'm going to get / start on some / homework,’ said the professor angrily.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is "start on some."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
__
 
• The error in the sentence is the phrase** "get start."**
 
• It should be corrected to** "get started." **
 
• **"Get started" **is the correct phrase, indicating the beginning of an action or activity.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

Correct sentence: *"I'm going to **get started**__ on some homework," said the professor angrily.*
